scope: One existing callable: listEatCleanAdminData. No new exports, Rules, indexes, triggers or business writes.

protocol.omittedSections: Full legacy response and source-limit/filter semantics preserved.
protocol.explicitResponse: Unrequested properties are omitted; section membership and source-limit coverage are explicit.
protocol.authorization: Current trusted admin is checked before input validation or business reads.
protocol.sharedReads: Configuration is read once for catalog initialization state. No extra collection query when the configuration exists.
protocol.legacyInitialization: If configuration and requested catalogs are empty/missing, at most one ID-only document per unchecked catalog determines global seeded state; date-filtered empty inventory is rechecked without its date filter.
protocol.orderJoins: Explicit filtered reads hydrate refund and delivery documents only for matching rows inside the existing newest-order window.
protocol.caps: Meals 200, inventory 500, orders requested 1-200/default100. limitReached is a conservative coverage flag, not proof of another page.

rollout.dependency: PR30 full admin route isolation; preserve Academy main/Rules in the final integration.
rollout.next: Implement and validate section-aware frontend caches before production cutover; deploy and verify the reader before activating explicit callers.

limitations: Existing unfiltered orders use their bounded newest-source window; status/date database predicates and pagination remain separate work.
No current frontend requests explicit sections yet; no runtime or billing savings claimed from preparation alone.
Other tabs must hide unloaded totals rather than presenting missing sections as zero.
No automatic refresh, data initialization or full history backfill is added.
